**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] User is writing a constitution document for a community user group in the UK.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To help write a constitution document, the assistant needs to know the purpose of the community user group, including its mission and objectives.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant needs to know the membership criteria, including who can join the group and how they can become members, as well as the rights and obligations of members.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant requires information on the governance structure, including how the group will be governed, who will make decisions, and the roles and responsibilities of any board or committee.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant needs details about meetings and decision-making processes, including how often the group will meet, how meetings will be conducted, and the rules for voting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant requires information on finances, including how the group will be financed, whether there will be membership fees or other sources of income, and the rules for managing and spending the group's funds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant needs to know how the constitution can be amended and the rules for doing so.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant requires information on the legal requirements for creating a constitution in the UK and how the group can ensure compliance with these requirements.
